d: AI Engineer - SeniorFieldDetailsLocationAbu Dhabi and Dubai, UAEEngagement ModelFull-timeLanguageArabic, EnglishEmployment TypeOCSDuration6 months

AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation.

The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows.

Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations

Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost

Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai's AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council

Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced
Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls
Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release
Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production

Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams

Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality
Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans
Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component
Lead capability building for Client's counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover
q: 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments
Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality
Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows
Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches
Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code
Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices
Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview
Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery
Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience
Relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
Experience in government or other regulated sectors

d: Legal Advisor oversees day-to-day litigation operations, ensures compliance with all court processes, provides legal decisions on labor investigation, taking the required legal actions. The role supports the Litigation Team by drafting and reviewing memos, pleadings, and other legal documents.
This position ensures that litigation procedures are executed efficiently and accurately, and in full compliance with the directives of the Legal & Compliance Executive Director.
r: Lead and manage all routine litigation files (civil, labor, commercial, etc.).
Review case files, draft pleadings, attend hearings, and monitor court timelines.
Escalate complex or high-risk matters to the Legal & Compliance Executive Director when necessary.
Ensure that the templates shared by the Legal & Compliance Director have been used by the Litigation Team.
Ensure proper tracking of deadlines, hearings, submissions, and court procedures.
Maintain litigation database and ensure accurate case updates.
Manage internal workflows and task assignments for supporting the Litigation Team.
Provide operational legal advice on routine claims, notices, and disputes.
Draft legal notices, responses, and settlement proposals.
Maintain structured case files and evidence records.
Ensure timely reporting to management on case status.
Train junior lawyers on procedural matters and litigation workflows.
Liaise with government bodies or regulators for matters requiring legal intervention.
Zero missed deadlines or procedural mistakes.
High accuracy in pleadings and legal filings.
Accurate, timely communication and updates to relevant departments.
Effective management of routine litigation files with minimal escalations.
Proper use of approved templates and adherence to department standards.

d: The Senior Manager – HR Business Partner acts as a strategic people advisor to senior business leaders, translating business priorities into effective workforce and people strategies.

The role partners closely with leadership and HR Centres of Excellence to drive workforce planning, organization effectiveness, talent and succession planning, performance management, employee engagement, change initiatives, and organizational capability while ensuring HR decisions are commercially sound and aligned with company policies.
The Senior Manager level is already established within Qiddiya's HRBP structure, for example Rayan Alharbi holds the title Senior Manager – HR Business Partner
q: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders on organizational, workforce, talent, and people-related matters.
Develop a strong understanding of the business strategy, operating model, priorities, and workforce challenges.
Translate business requirements into practical HR strategies and interventions.
Challenge and influence leadership decisions where necessary to ensure effective people and organizational outcomes.

Use workforce data, dashboards, and people metrics to provide actionable insights and support leadership decision-making, consistent with Qiddiya's existing HRBP expectations. [Re: HR Bus...tner roles | Outlook]
Lead strategic workforce and headcount planning for assigned business areas.
Identify current and future capability requirements and workforce gaps.
Advise leadership on organizational structures, spans and layers, role requirements, and workforce optimization.
Partner with Organization Development and relevant HR teams on restructures and organization design initiatives.
Support workforce forecasting and manpower planning in line with business growth and transformation priorities.
Partner with leaders to identify critical roles, high-potential employees, and succession requirements.
Facilitate talent reviews, succession planning, and development discussions.
Identify capability gaps and work with Talent Management and Learning & Development to establish appropriate interventions.
Support leadership in building strong internal talent pipelines and improving retention of critical capabilities.
Guide leaders through goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and performance improvement processes.
Facilitate effective performance and talent discussions with senior leadership teams.
Support managers in addressing underperformance and establishing appropriate Performance Improvement Plans.
Promote a strong performance culture based on accountability, transparency, and continuous feedback.
Provide guidance on complex and sensitive employee relations matters.
Partner with relevant HR specialists on disciplinary cases, grievances, workplace concerns, and other employee matters.
Analyze engagement feedback and workforce trends to identify organizational issues and recommend interventions.
Coach managers on effective people management and employee engagement.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development , or a related discipline.
Professional HR certification such as CIPD, SHRM-SCP, SPHR/HRCI , or equivalent is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Saudi labor regulations and HR practices.
12+ years of progressive HR experience , with significant experience in an HR Business Partnering capacity.
Demonstrated experience partnering with senior executives and business leaders.
Strong experience in workforce planning, organization design, talent and succession management, performance management, employee relations, and change management .
Experience supporting large, complex, or rapidly transforming organizations.
